ns2:course.label: Marching Illini
ns2:course.description: Prepares and performs music of the highest available quality in at least six shows per football season. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. 1 to 3 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Audition required and/or consent of instructor.
